Class DriveInputProcessor

java.lang.Object
com.stuypulse.robot.util.swerve.DriveInputProcessor
public class DriveInputProcessor extends Object

DriveInputProcessor

Class for processing driver input for the drivetrain. It's intended to replace StuyLib's VStream and Filters and use pure WPILib and Java.

This will be used to be as close as the original StuyLib implementation as possible It will be used for

  • Applying deadbands
  • Applying power curves
  • Limiting magnitude to 1
  • Scaling to max velocity
  • Applying rate limits
  • Applying a low pass filter

To use within a command, create an instance of this class and call the update() method in the start of the Command.

To get the processed speed, call the get() method.

  • Constructor Details

    • DriveInputProcessor

      public DriveInputProcessor(org.wpilib.command3.button.CommandGamepad controller, double deadband, double power, org.wpilib.units.measure.LinearVelocity maxVelocity, org.wpilib.units.measure.LinearAcceleration maxAcceleration, double rc)

      Constructor for the DriveInputProcessor

      Creates a new DriveInputProcessor with the specified parameters and processes the input periodically.

      Parameters:
      controller - The CommandXboxController to get driver input from
      deadband - The deadband to apply to the input (0-1)
      power - The power to apply to the input
      maxVelocity - The maximum velocity to scale the input to
      maxAcceleration - The maximum acceleration to apply to the input
      rc - The time constant for the low pass filter (seconds)

    • update

      public void update()
      Update method that processes all filters and updates the filtered speed. This should be called once per cycle in the Command using this processor, before retrieving the processed velocity vector via get().
